decisions.reason: The existing message-184 MODIFY already records the FAQ explanation of Transak wallet creation, direct NFT delivery, and fiat-buyer reward access.
The existing message-184 MODIFY already records automatic non-custodial wallet provisioning, its purpose, and direct NFT mint delivery through Transak.
The existing message-184 MODIFY already records the required Transak confirmation email and its mint number, NFT details, and dashboard link contents.
The existing message-184 MODIFY already records that a Transak fiat buyer receives the NFT mint number as the referral code in the confirmation email.
Automatic wallet creation and direct NFT delivery do not change the mint price, founder share, referral commission, prize-pool funding, or fiat-fee treatment.
The Transak wallet and fulfillment decision does not change whether tipping is offered or how the tipping control operates.
The existing message-184 MODIFY already records automatic prize transfer, removes the obsolete claim interaction, and adds the stated winner notifications.
The ebook reader behavior is established by a separate clause in the same message and is not changed by the fiat mint fulfillment decision.
The source decision concerns fulfillment for a Transak buyer and does not alter reward routing when a mint has no referral code.
The wallet provisioning and NFT delivery flow does not change which sale types fund prize pools or the funding duration.
The message retains dashboard access through an email link and optionally SIWE; it does not replace or modify the existing email-based dashboard authentication requirement.
The reference to on-chain fair randomness is consistent with the existing Chainlink VRF selection requirement and introduces no change to winner selection.
